lines.en: label ayanespecial40:
scene ayanecantbone1
I’m not going to lie, not having Makoto around fucking sucks.
Because, in addition to being one of the girls I am currently allowed to have sex with (Thanks, Maya), her not being here is beginning to increase the amount of time I have to spend in this building.
And it certainly doesn’t help that Imani is a pretty good teacher and has actually started assigning work to the girls.
Now, you may be asking yourself, just how much paperwork can there possibly be for a class of twenty-ish who receive maybe one written assignment per week. And the answer to that is simple.
There is paperwork.
It’s not a large amount. In fact, the amount I have to handle is so minuscule that I’m sure Wakana would mock and ridicule me if she could only hear my thoughts.
But when you don’t want to work, any amount of work at all is too much.
I have far too many things to think about.
And far too many girls to have sex with.
: Come in.
scene ayanecantbone2
Or not.
: Good! You’re still here. I was worried you may have left with Ami and Maya.
: Is there any reason you didn’t leave with Ami and Maya?
: Swim club, obviously.
: Ahh, yes. I can see that it’s going very well by the fact that...you are here and not there.
scene ayanecantbone3
: Yeah...I got halfway there and then thought to myself- you know what, Ayane? It’s been a long time since you’ve hung out with Sensei in his office after school. You should go do that.
: Good on you for being mentally stable. You’ll have more free time that way.
scene ayanecantbone4
: I wouldn’t mind being a little crazier if it meant I got to spend more time with you.
: And, at the rate things have been going lately, that seems like it might be a real possibility!
: Is the fact that this is all some sort of infinite cycle finally starting to weigh on you?
scene ayanecantbone5
: Of course. I just haven’t quite figured out the right way to talk about it yet because I don’t understand nearly as much as you and Maya even with all of the questions I’ve asked her.
: Which is doubly annoying since it’s starting to seem like being the “runner up” just might be who I am as a person.
: You’re not a runner up at all, Ayane. You’re...Well, you’re you.
scene ayanecantbone6
: Yeah. Second place to Ami when it comes to your list of interpersonal priorities and second to Maya when it comes to your list of...apocalyptic ones.
: If you weight the points you get from both of those categories, I think that would put you in first.
scene ayanecantbone7
: Sensei, I’m being serious right now. This is all still really scary to me and there are so many things I don’t understand.
: Also, I’m worried that if I have to go any longer without having sex with you that my vagina is going to close up and we’ll never be able to have sex again.
: What were you saying about going insane just a minute ago? Because I think that sentence may have just put you over the edge.
scene ayanecantbone8
: You know...when I first heard that abstinence suggestion thingy from Maya...I thought to myself, “That sounds hard and annoying...but I think I can do it for the sake of science.”
scene ayanecantbone9
: Now? Now, I just want you to pin me down and fuck my brains out until I can’t even move anymore.
: Please don’t say things like that to me when I’ve been doing so well with this so far.
scene ayanecantbone6
: But...Sensei! Think about it for a second...
: Why should we even have to do this in the first place? It doesn’t make any sense.
: It’s for Maya’s...theory or whatever.
: Yes, I know that. But what would even be the point of proving that theory?
: Isn’t me finally showing up after...the bajillions of times you guys have done it a step in the right direction? Won’t getting rid of me just send you backwards?
: First off, I’ve only done it a handful of times. Maya’s the one who has reached  “bajillions” territory...possibly.
: I’m fine with suffering for the sake of you being happy. I am. But-
: I’m not asking you to suffer, Ayane. In fact, I’m not the one asking you anything at all.
: I know. You’d never ask me to do something like that. But the truth is that I am. And I’m not just talking about the sex at this point even if that is an admittedly huge part of it.
scene ayanecantbone10
: I just...
: I can’t help but feel like if Maya is right and everything does work out...
: That I’ll just go back to being excluded again...
scene ayanecantbone11
: Listen, uhh...
: Can we sit on the couch if I promise not to try and have sex with you? Doing things this way makes it feel too much like counseling and I kind of need you to feel like you right now.
: Sure. But I’m blaming you if Imani yells at me for not finishing all of this grading stuff on time.
: I probably shouldn’t be encouraging this type of behavior when the school has already decided you needed a student teacher, but...grades should be the last of your priorities right now...
scene black
Ayane moves over to the couch and curls herself up into a ball, waiting for me to come join her as I slide the remainder of my “work” back into my desk.
I understand where these worries are coming from. Especially when, for the most part, she’s kept them bottled up ever since the three of us “respawned” in this very room.
But that’s what Ayane does. She keeps things to herself until she literally can’t anymore.
And if she’s worried enough about this to actively seek me out...and shirk responsibilities she personally signed up for...
Something must really be wrong.
scene ayanecantbone12
: Thank you. I needed this.

: I’m sure it’ll sound stupid since it’s something you’ve been shouldering for a long time, but...I guess my shoulders aren’t as big as yours. Which means this whole thing has been really hard for me so far.
scene ayanecantbone13
: And you’ve been great...really.
: But...Maya, on the other hand...
: Maya cares about you.
: Does she?
: Uh...probably? I guess it’s hard to ever really know anything with-
: If she cares about me, why is her top priority right now making sure I don’t get any closer to either one of you?
: If the whole pregnancy theory thing is true and I don’t get to come with you guys to the roof next time...won’t I just be...you know, reset? Why would she do that to me?
scene ayanecantbone14
: That’s not exactly how things work, I don’t think.
: It seems that, so long as nothing happens to me, everyone keeps most of their memories. And only some things wind up getting wiped away after Maya does...whatever it is she does.
: But those are still my memories. Memories I want to keep because they’re memories that brought me closer to you.
: It shouldn’t be up to Maya to decide that I should just throw them away to put an end to a little bet that she has with herself.
: If you’re so confident that her theory is wrong...it shouldn’t be a problem, though. Right?
scene ayanecantbone15
: I mean...kind of?
: I guess?...
: It’s less about the theory itself and more about what asking us to go through with it means.
: I still think she’s wrong and I still think I’ll be able to stay with you guys, but I’m worried that she doesn’t want me to.
: Like she...wants this weird, paranormal universe to be one for just the two of you. And that she’s so used to different versions of me getting discarded that I’m barely even a human to her anymore.
: I wish...she wasn’t so hard to understand sometimes, you know?
: Trust me. I know.
scene ayanecantbone16
: So...what now, then? What else can we do while we wait for the next thing to happen?
: Just...wait, I guess. That’s all I normally do.
: No wonder you guys haven’t made any progress. There has to be, like...something we can do to find out more about this, right?
: Sure. It’s never too late to start studying chronokinetics. Act now and Wakana may even take you into her class. You’ll certainly have more luck with something like that there.
: Sensei-
: I don’t know what you want me to say, Ayane.
: I get that you’re scared. And I’m here to...try and make you feel better in whatever sort of sexless way I can.
: But, despite having experienced this more than you, I really don’t know that much. And I have no idea what we can do to find out more.
: If you have any ideas, I’ll be happy to indulge them. But right now, all we have is Maya’s...so I still think the best course of action is just figuring out if she’s right or not.
: If she’s right, though...aren’t you worried that the current me won’t come back?
: Or will any old version of me do?...
: What is that supposed to mean?
: Do you love me?...Or do you love me?
: That is...way too deep of a question for regular office hours.
: Besides, Maya finding out that she’s wrong about the one thing she thinks she knows more about than everyone could be a very humbling experience for her and, not gonna lie, I think she needs that.
scene ayanecantbone17

: Fine. But just so you know, if I make it to that roof again after X months of not having sex with you and don’t have my brain wiped, I am throwing myself at you with a level of aggression you have never seen before.
: I don’t think Maya will be very happy about that.
: I honestly don’t care.
: I mean...yeah. If we manage to prove that’s not why you’re showing up, I’m not going to reject any of your advances.
scene ayanecantbone18
: We?
: So...you’re on my side now?
: There are sides? Is my life not already complicated enough having to fend off so many girls vying for my affection?
: Oh, please. As if you’re fighting any of them off.
: I’m not talking about an Ayane vs Maya, choose your heroine battle. I’m talking about whether or not you think getting me pregnant is the key to all of this world’s mysteries.
: I think that if it is, I am going to be more confused than ever. So, sure. Go ahead and chalk that up to me being on your side.
: But I will not get sucked into whatever spat you and Maya start with one another. So please do not tell her I said that.
scene ayanecantbone12
: I won’t. I don’t have any intention of starting any problems with Maya. I love her.
: I just don’t want her trying to tackle this entire burden herself when she finally has a friend willing to take on some of it for her.
: I have no idea what the future holds for any of us...and despite how confident I am, I can’t even guarantee my short-term future anymore.
: And who knows? Maybe we never wind up learning anything.
: Maybe this loop never breaks and we all wind up complacently conquering the end of the world together. Over and over and over and over...
scene ayanecantbone18
: But we’ll be doing it together.
: And none of us will ever have to feel...left out or...
scene ayanecantbone19
: Or like we’re the runner up ever again.
: I do love you, you know.
scene ayanecantbone20
: Huh?
: To answer your question from before.
: The you you are now is the only Ayane Amamiya I care about. And if anything were to ever happen to you, I doubt I’d be able to look at you the same.
: Sensei...
: But that doesn’t mean I wouldn’t still have sex with the other Ayanes.
scene ayanecantbone21
: I can’t tell if I’m horny because of the way you just told me you loved me, the fact that we haven’t had sex in what feels like a whole year, or the idea of you having sex with my clones.
: Cloning you sounds fun. I don’t think I’d be able to handle more than three Ayanes at once, though.
: I think I would also cut myself off at three Senseis.
: That sounds...painful.
: That sounds amazing.
scene ayanecantbone22
: Okay! We should probably call it a day here since I know what you are thinking and you know what I am thinking.
: If Hell exists, this is it.
scene ayanecantbone23
: Yes, Sensei.
: Yes it is.
scene black
Ayane leaves my office and...
And I wind up heading over to the school restroom to relieve myself before going home for the day.
Maya is lucky that I feel like my existence rests in the palms of her hands. Because otherwise, I would have gone against her wishes at least three times in the last hour.
One for every single Ayane clone I imagined having sex with as I was jerking off in the bathroom.
